channel.title: Kinsu Health: guides
channel.description: Plain guides to keeping medical records, taking medicines on time and caring for family, for Indian families.

item.title: How to organise your family’s medical records: a simple system that lasts
item.description: A plain way to sort prescriptions, lab reports, scans and discharge summaries for the whole family, on paper and on your phone, so you can find them in a minute.

item.title: The hospital file: what belongs in it, and how to stop losing pages
item.description: Admission, bills, reports, discharge summary: what to collect during a hospital stay, how to keep it together, and what to copy before you send the originals.

item.title: What to take to a doctor’s appointment: a checklist you can print
item.description: The papers, readings and questions that make a short appointment count, with a free printable checklist for your next visit.
